title: cloudflare_dns_record apply fails with 'Provider produced inconsistent result' on modified_on after upgrading to 5.26
symptoms: Provider produced inconsistent result after apply ... .modified_on: was ... but now ...
Every existing record plans + include_shadow_metadata = false
The records do update in Cloudflare even though apply errors
cause: Provider 5.26.0 added include_shadow_metadata and planned modified_on as unchanged, so the server side timestamp change looked inconsistent. 5.27.0 was incomplete and 5.28.0 fixed both the spurious diff and the error.
fix: Upgrade the provider to 5.28.0 or later and run plan again.
